items.title: Dick Hyman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: And that bass player, what’s her name, Parrott, Vicky is her name?

ctx.x: And I just wonder where is it going? How can it keep changing so fast? Do you have any opinions on what’s going to happen with it? When I look at this jazz party scene, it’s really wonderful to be at, I wonder how long it can keep going.
One of the most remarkable things about this party is the way that Mat [Domber] has been including women. And that bass player, what’s her name, Parrott, Vicky is her name?
